St. Moritz

The sunny high valley of the Engadin, host of two Winter Olympics.

Plan a trip to St. Moritz

In short

St. Moritz at a glance.

St. Moritz lies at about 1,800 m in the Upper Engadin, with Corviglia above the village and a frozen lake below it in deep winter.

Region
Graubünden, Switzerland
Winter Olympics
1928 and 1948
Nearest airports
Zurich (about 3 hours); Engadin Airport in Samedan for private flights
Best for
Skiing with style, winter events on the lake

Who is it for?

Guests who want classic grand hotels, sunny pistes and a winter calendar full of events.

When to go?

Winter for skiing and the events on the frozen lake; summer for hiking, biking and the Engadin lakes.

How do you get there?

About three hours from Zurich by car or train. Private flights land at Engadin Airport in Samedan, a few minutes away.
